properties.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
properties.context: Landing site and access point to the crater floor and western delta.
properties.summary: The rover's landing site; the operational origin for the traverse. Useful as a control point, not as a high-priority science target.
properties.coordinate_note: Approximate; nearest rover daily position used as proxy. Refine with HiRISE and rover operations target database.
properties.confidence_reason: PDS localization and mission records; high confidence in position and context.

properties.name: Séítah
properties.context: Coarsely crystalline olivine-rich rock; Mg–Fe carbonates along grain boundaries; sulfates and perchlorates in voids.
properties.summary: A high-value igneous and alteration target. It records ancient magmatic processes and later water–rock interaction, but it is not the strongest biosignature host.
properties.coordinate_note: Approximate; nearest rover daily position used as proxy. Refine with HiRISE and rover operations target database.
properties.confidence_reason: Multiple rover instruments and published stratigraphy; the cumulate interpretation is well supported but not unique.

properties.name: Máaz
properties.context: Overlying igneous unit interpreted as lava flows or a layered igneous body; aqueous alteration is present.
properties.summary: A moderate geological target that helps reconstruct the igneous sequence and the timing of alteration.
properties.coordinate_note: Approximate; nearest rover daily position used as proxy. Refine with HiRISE and rover operations target database.
properties.confidence_reason: Rover observations and a published interpretation; the emplacement mechanism remains debated.

properties.name: Western delta front / Shenandoah Formation
properties.context: Laminated mudstone, sandstone, granule conglomerate; five facies and three facies associations; lacustrine/deltaic transition.
properties.summary: A high-value sedimentary and habitability target. Fine-grained rocks at the fan front are a strong preservation context, but no definitive biosignature has been reported.
properties.coordinate_note: Approximate; nearest rover daily position used as proxy. Refine with HiRISE and rover operations target database.
properties.confidence_reason: Rover stratigraphy and published facies analysis; lateral continuity is inferred.

properties.name: Upper delta / Cape Nukshak vicinity
properties.context: Layered strata, boulder conglomerate, and scarp; delta-top setting.
properties.summary: A high-value stratigraphic target with excellent outcrop exposure. Access is constrained by the scarp and boulder-rich terrain.
properties.coordinate_note: Approximate; nearest rover daily position used as proxy. Refine with HiRISE and rover operations target database.
properties.confidence_reason: Rover images and stratigraphy; scarp access is not fully characterized.

properties.name: Neretva Vallis entry
properties.context: Valley-floor outcrops and the approach to Bright Angel; fluvial history.
properties.summary: A high-value fluvial target and the gateway to Bright Angel. The valley floor provides a relatively continuous transect through the river system.
properties.coordinate_note: Approximate; nearest rover daily position used as proxy. Refine with HiRISE and rover operations target database.
properties.confidence_reason: Rover observations and valley context; the flow history is not fully resolved.

properties.name: Bright Angel / Cheyava Falls
properties.context: Organic-carbon-bearing mudstones; sub-millimetre Fe-phosphate nodules; millimetre-scale reaction fronts; likely vivianite and greigite.
properties.summary: The strongest documented potential biosignature target in the region. The observations are compelling but the biological interpretation is unresolved; returned-sample analysis is required.
properties.coordinate_note: Approximate; nearest rover daily position used as proxy. Refine with HiRISE and rover operations target database.
properties.confidence_reason: Strong rover observations; the biological interpretation is unresolved and sample return is required.

properties.name: Margin Unit / Mandu Wall
properties.context: Inner crater rim; orbital carbonate detections; possible lacustrine carbonates.
properties.summary: A high-value orbital target with a strong carbonate hypothesis, but limited ground truth. Access is difficult because of the steep rim.
properties.coordinate_note: Approximate; nearest rover daily position used as proxy. Refine with HiRISE and rover operations target database.
properties.confidence_reason: Orbital carbonate detections; limited ground truth and steep access.

properties.name: Western rim traverse
properties.context: Diverse rim materials; regional structure; context for the Margin Unit.
properties.summary: A contextual target for rim structure and regional geology. It is far from the landing site and poorly characterized at outcrop scale.
properties.coordinate_note: Approximate; nearest rover daily position used as proxy. Refine with HiRISE and rover operations target database.
properties.confidence_reason: Regional mapping and sparse ground truth.
